MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The HDMI cable was the closest match because my DVI cable purchase suggests that practical display connections can be relevant to me.",
    "A cable fits the purpose of several of my past purchases: connecting existing equipment. However, I would need an actual HDMI connection to make before choosing it."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Streaming sticks and Alexa devices introduce uses I have not shown interest in; they do not help with the computer connections reflected in my history.",
    "The memory cards assume a storage need and a compatible device that my history does not establish.",
    "My headset had a microphone for use with a phone or tablet; that does not give me a reason to want a portable Bluetooth speaker."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations seem to treat interest in computer accessories as interest in electronics generally.",
    "Several streaming sticks and smart speakers repeat the same assumption that I want home entertainment or voice assistant devices."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My connection purchases have specific purposes and interfaces: USB expansion, Wi-Fi, DVI, and USB-to-Ethernet. The particular connection matters more than a broad resemblance between devices.",
    "My purchases are spaced far apart, and I rarely interact without a relevant need. Even a related accessory is not an automatic next purchase.",
    "My latest interaction involved wired networking, which gives me more reason to consider relevant connectivity accessories than unrelated entertainment devices."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized an interest in electronics but missed my more specific pattern of occasional, practical purchases for connecting existing equipment."
}
